decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 3 - The facing brickwork to be used for the outbuilding shall match that used at the adjoining outbuilding at No 161 Kingsley Road.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached outbuilding shall only be used for a purpose incidental to No. 159 Kingley Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include kitchen facilities).
description: Erection of a part single, part two storey rear extension to the house and erection of a detached single outbuilding for use as a gym to the rear.
